objective: Produce a private 60-second Via demo ('find a real confession time and save a plan') with the Demo Studio workflow (skills/personal/demo-studio/SKILL.md): claim ledger first, real Playwright captures for every product claim, locally generated illustrative media on Beast, Kokoro narration, automated quality gate, independent review, and a human checkpoint before anything leaves the artifact root.
constraints: Follow the Demo Studio stages in order; every stage writes its file under studio/via-60s/ in the Score artifact root. Nothing is committed to a repository.
Every verified or configured claim cites a commit, run, job or receipt; generated media may carry only illustrative claims and must be labeled 'Illustrative' on screen.
Local generation only (ComfyUI and Kokoro on Beast); cloud generation budget is zero. No paid provider calls.
No voice or likeness of a real person, no generated people presented as users or clergy, no generated UI presented as Via, no third-party logos.
Captures use synthetic or already-public Lorain data on a throwaway instance; no tokens, admin screens or personal routine data appear on screen.
Never print or store secrets. The quality gate (studio_check.py --require-media) must pass on the exact final.mp4 before review; never edit the checker to pass.
Reviewer is a different identity from the builder for every task. Nothing is published, uploaded or sent; D5 ends at a human checkpoint.

tasks.title: Brief, capabilities probe, claim ledger and shot list
tasks.instructions: Run Demo Studio stages 0-3 for slug via-60s. Probe Beast capabilities (ComfyUI /system_stats and installed loaders, Kokoro, ffmpeg, ffprobe, tesseract, Playwright) and record them. Build claims.json from mastalink/via evidence (docs/CURRENT_STATE.md, docs/reviews/, benchmark outputs, merged commits); where docs and code disagree, cite the code and note the drift. Write shots.json for 60 seconds within 10%. Run studio_check.py on the project and include its JSON output. Return strict JSON {"artifacts": {"claims": {"path", "sha256"}, "shots": {"path", "sha256"}, "capabilities": {"path", "sha256"}}, "gate": <studio_check output>}.

tasks.title: Real Playwright captures for every product claim
tasks.instructions: Using the accepted D1 shots.json, record each capture shot with Playwright against a throwaway local Via web build seeded with synthetic or public Lorain data, fixed 1280x720 viewport, scripted path, exact shot durations. No tokens, admin screens or personal data on screen. Hash every clip into assets.json. Return strict JSON with each clip path and sha256 and the exact Via commit captured.

tasks.title: Local illustrative renders and Kokoro narration on Beast
tasks.instructions: Render every generated and diagram shot from the accepted D1 shots.json with ComfyUI on Beast using API-format workflows saved under studio/workflows/, fixed seeds, and 'Illustrative' labels; render narration per shot with local Kokoro. Record generator, model, seed, prompt, license and sha256 for every file in assets.json. If a needed model is not installed, substitute a diagram or still pan and record why; do not install models or call cloud APIs. Return strict JSON with asset paths and sha256.

tasks.title: Assemble final.mp4 with captions and pass the quality gate
tasks.instructions: Assemble the accepted D2 and D3 assets into final.mp4 (1280x720, H.264, AAC, loudnorm I=-16), captions.srt, narration.txt and poster.png per Demo Studio stage 5. Run studio_check.py --video final.mp4 --require-media and fix every finding without editing the checker. Return strict JSON with final.mp4 sha256, duration, and the passing gate output.

tasks.title: Independent claim-by-claim review of the exact final.mp4
tasks.instructions: Independently review the exact final.mp4 accepted in D4 by sha256: watch it or read a 1-frame-per-2-seconds contact sheet plus narration.txt, re-check every claim against its cited evidence, confirm generated shots are labeled and carry only illustrative claims, and confirm no secret or personal data is visible. Write review.json {verdict, video_sha256, findings}. Do not upload, publish or send anything; the owner decides at the checkpoint.

checkpoint.reason: Owner watches the exact reviewed final.mp4 and decides whether and where it is shared.
